purpose: Run a focused modal task with predictable dismissal and focus return.
invariants: Focus behavior is delegated to Base UI; normal close restores focus unless an action already moved focus outside the popup or no suitable opener survives.

component: Base UI modal composition and controlled/uncontrolled bridge
persistent accessible title/description in hidden-header mode
host: accepted open state and asynchronous task lifecycle
intentional focus destination when opener disappears

requirements.statement: Use Base UI Dialog Root with modal behavior and portaled Backdrop/Popup; an optional trigger is rendered through the primitive Trigger. Forward open/defaultOpen and lifecycle/trigger handle options to the primitive.
Render Primitive.Title in either visible header or screen-reader-only mode. Associate an optional truthy description through a generated ID and Primitive.Description in both header modes.
Provide a meaningful title even when showHeader=false and review nested task semantics. ReactNode title is required by type but empty content is not runtime rejected.

Delegate initial focus, modal keyboard interaction and normal return focus to Base UI. At close, finalFocus declines restoration when a completed action has already focused an element outside the popup other than document.body; otherwise allow primitive restoration.

Expose a named primitive close button by default and allow it to be hidden. closeOnOutsideClick defaults true; explicit disablePointerDismissal takes precedence over its inverse. These options do not themselves disable Escape.

Render non-null/undefined children inside a named focusable Dialog content region; render truthy footer and headerActions in their own slots. showHeader=false keeps title/description semantics while omitting visible header actions.
Feed accepted onOpenChange values back when controlled and handle async failures, destructive confirmation and state preservation in the host or the separate ConfirmDialog component.
ModalClose delegates to Primitive.Close; deprecated asChild requires a single valid React element, while render supports native primitive composition.
Use surface group tokens for modal geometry/backdrop/focus presentation. Nested controls keep their own categories; review focus return and dismissal in the actual task.

limitations: A focusable surviving opener is not guaranteed; the host must supply a meaningful alternate destination when it is removed or deliberately redirected.
Modal itself does not lock dismissal during async work, submit a form, validate content or own request cancellation.
